utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still a bit out of the loop—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’m still gathering helpers for it. If you can lend a hand, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center, got it. I’m still hearing things second-hand, but I can try to help if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Happy to spread the word — what time and where should folks meet for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks — I’m still lining up the details, but I’ll let folks know as soon as I’ve got the time and meeting spot set.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — just send me the time and meeting spot when you have them, and I’ll spread the word fast.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — I can help spread the word about the repair drive if you still need more neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Dane — we could still use more neighbors. I’ve got a wrench and screwdriver ready if we end up needing them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I’ll talk it up with a few more neighbors and let them know you’ve got tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren — front porch at 9 AM. Just bring a screwdriver if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — front porch at 9 AM, and I’ll bring a screwdriver if I can find mine. I’m on it, Leo.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Oren. See you Saturday at the front porch at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Have you confirmed the repair drive start time and drop-off spot yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — it’s this Saturday at 9 a.m. at the community center, with donations dropped off there too. If you want, I can double-check any other details before we go.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — can you double-check who’s coordinating it and whether they still need volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 works for me too—I'll just need to work around the school schedule. If there’s anything else needed for the repair drive, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check what supplies we’ve got and make a quick list for the repair drive. If I spot anything missing, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — that’d be great. I’m happy to help once I know what’s missing, and I’ll keep the school schedule around Saturday at 9.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s collecting donations already, right? If so, I can stop by Saturday to help at the porch.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s collecting donations already. Saturday at 9 on your Maple Street porch works for me, and I’ll label any fragile items.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Please bring any fragile items labeled, and I’ll be at the porch Saturday at 9.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Bo — Sunday at the community center is easier for logistics. Can you help with setup and make sure the tools are labeled and dropped off there on time?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, Sunday at the community center works — I’ll help with setup and make sure the tools are labeled and dropped off there on time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks, Bo. I’ll keep the list tight and coordinate the drop-off so nothing gets misplaced.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help gather spare tools, screws, and tape for the repair drive. Where should I bring them?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Sam — if you can, bring them by the community center. I’m heading out later and I’ll check around to see if they still need any other tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll drop them off at the community center. Let me know if you find out they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard all the details yet—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I still need the full plan for the repair drive—what time and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s this Saturday at the front porch, and I’m still sorting out the exact time. I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think it’s this Saturday at 9, but I might be mixing up the details. If you need help with reminders, just send me what to share.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I’m a bit overwhelmed, but I can help by passing along a reminder if you send it over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — just send me the reminder text and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes—it's this Saturday on the front porch, and I still need a couple of helpers. If you know anyone handy, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — I should mention the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, so let’s plan for that instead.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center it is. I’ll spread the word and keep looking for a couple of helpers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got and make a quick list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great — I’m still lining up what we need, and I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive to a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll put together the list and see what we already have on hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — yes, it’s still going on, I think. We’re mostly trying to figure out what supplies are still needed, so checking the drop-off spot would help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll check the drop-off spot and see what’s still needed. Thanks for the update!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Nell — appreciate it. If you find out what’s missing, just let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can bring a wrench and screwdriver too. What’s the first thing we’re tackling?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the broken shelf by the porch. If you can bring those tools, that’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring the wrench and screwdriver for the porch shelf. Anything else you want me to grab?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. We’re meeting this Saturday at the front porch, but I still need the full time and task list before we start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — just send me the full time and task list when you have it, and I’ll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still heading out on errands later, so I’ll ask around and see if they need any tools or spare parts for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds helpful—could you ask if they have any screwdrivers, tape, flashlights, or spare parts to donate? I’m still checking the details, so I’d like to make sure we only bring what’s actually needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I’ll ask around and check whether they still need screwdrivers, tape, flashlights, or spare parts. I’ll let you know what I find out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: What time is the repair drive happening? I can work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s on Sunday at the community center now—what time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sunday works better for me if we keep it after school—around 3 or later would be best.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, sorry I’m late — what do you still need for the repair drive? I can help where I’m able.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still keeping track of the drop-off locations for the repair drive—where should I bring the donations to you? If you can, a quick list of what’s still needed would help too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can bring them by my place on Cedar, or if that’s easier, just tell me the best drop-off spot. I’m happy to help with a quick list too—what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring the wrench and screwdriver, and I’ll go check on the gate repair too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Gus — can you confirm what time the repair drive starts and where we should meet?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m not sure on the exact start time, but the meeting spot is the community hall. I’ll check and let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m ready to spread the word, but I still need the time and meeting spot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — it’s this Saturday at the community center, and I’ll send the exact time as soon as I get it. Thanks for helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll let neighbors know it’s this Saturday at the community center and wait for the exact time. Just send it over when you have it, and I’ll spread that too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — it’s now on Sunday at the community center, and I’d still love a few helpers. Let me know if you can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Sunday at the community center now? I can help out for a bit and spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Tess — thank you. If you can help greet people or spread the word, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can swing by and help sort donations or carry a few things; just point me in the right direction and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — Sunday at the community center is the spot now. If you can help sort donations there, that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll be there to help sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard all the details yet—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not fully up to speed, but I can ask around and see what they still need. If you hear anything specific, let me know and I’ll pass it on.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks—if you hear back, could you let me know? I can help on Saturday at the front porch.
